Question 3

Consider a matrix equation A−1x=B−1d, where A and B are 5×5 non-singular matrices, while x and d are 5×1 column vectors. Solve the equation for x.

a
x=B−1Ad
b
x=B−1dA
c
x=AB−1d
d
x=A−1B−1d
e
x=B−1dA−1
